done_when: send_message returns the host's real delivery result or a clear not-confirmed note, and a rate-limited IPC request waits for the next pass instead of being archived, proven by host and runner tests

findings.body: The supplied standard requires: "Tests build their own data with factories, own that data, don't depend on order, and never sleep." This new host test waits a fixed 200 ms before checking the deferred request. Only Date is faked, so this is a real wall-clock sleep. Drive the watcher timers deterministically or observe a completed processing pass instead.
findings.title: Standard: Tests never sleep

why: Agents are told a message was sent before it is delivered, and overloaded messages are thrown away
